Ghost Discipline is a trading journal that locks your risk rules before emotion gets a vote — then scores, honestly, whether you traded the plan.

About & Reset

What Ghost Discipline is actually for — and how to start clean.

What This Journal Is For

Ghost Discipline exists to make you accountable to the rules you set for yourself before emotion gets a vote. Every trade you log, every rule you break or hold, and every check-in you complete feeds a single outcome: honest proof of whether you traded the plan, or just traded the moment.

Over weeks and months this becomes a record you can't argue with — your discipline score, your rule violations, your real win rate under your own rules. It isn't here to flatter you. It's here to keep score honestly, so the next version of you trades better than the last.

Request a Review

Review a completed period across results, risk limits, and execution habits. Choose the previous week or month to open a concise performance summary.

Display & Motion

Turns down 3D tilt and entrance effects across the app if they're distracting or triggering motion sensitivity. Your browser's own reduced-motion setting is respected automatically either way.

Reduce motion
Full 3D tilt and entrance motion

Danger Zone

Starting over on a new live account? Clear Data permanently wipes every trade, rule, streak, discipline history and journal entry on this account and sends you back to Rule Builder to set up clean. This cannot be undone, and it requires a reset code from your admin.
